scripts.dev: mkdir -p web/dist && ([ -f web/dist/index.html ] || printf '<!doctype html><title>Forge</title>' > web/dist/index.html) && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.agent:deploy:prod: gcloud run deploy forge-agent --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 1800 --concurrency 1 --min-instances 0 --max-instances 5 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic,LLM_MODEL=deepseek-flash,PI_LLM_API=anthropic-messages,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret:latest
scripts.agent:deploy:staging: gcloud run deploy forge-agent-staging --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 1800 --concurrency 1 --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4,LLM_MODEL=glm-5.3-flash,PI_LLM_API=openai-completions,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,PI_THINKING_FORMAT=zai,PI_SUPPORTS_DEVELOPER_ROLE=false,PI_MODEL_INPUT_IMAGE=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key-staging:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret-staging:latest
